Report Description/// NOAA/NESDIS MPSR ISSUED FOR: GULF OF AMERICA /// POSSIBLE, UNCONFIRMED OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. REPORT DATE: 04-29-2025 REPORT TIME: 0500 UTC REGION: GULF OF AMERICA SUB REGION: N/A AREA/BLOCK: SOUTH PASS 15 IMAGE DATE: 04-28-2025 IMAGE TIME: 1704 UTC DATA SOURCE: PLANETSCOPE MODE: MULTISPECTRAL RESOLUTION: 3 METER LOCATION: 29°02"49" N/89°07"11" W AREA: 11.62 SQUARE KILOMETERS CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM-HIGH REPORT MAP/GIS FILES: HTTPS://WWW.OSPO.NOAA.GOV/PRODUCTS/OCEAN/MARINEPOLLUTION/ REMARKS: POSSIBLE OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THIS ANOMALY IS UNCONFIRMED AS OIL. THE SLICK SPANNED OVER APPROXIMATELY 5.67 NM LONG AND APPROX. 5.24 NM WIDE. IT HAD A STRONG CONTRAST AGAINST THE OCEAN BACKGROUND WHICH MADE IT DISTINGUISHABLE FROM NATURAL PHENOMENA/SEEPS. THERE WERE SILVER AND WHITE SHIMMER PARTS THROUGHOUT THE SLICK WHICH INDICATED THE PRESENCE OF RELATIVELY THICKER OIL. WINDS NEAR THE TIME OF THE IMAGE WERE COMING FROM THE E AT 9 KT. UNCERTAINTIES: THE FULL EXTENT OF THE SLICK WAS UNKNOWN DUE TO FALSE POSITIVES IN THE AREA. ***WEB REPORT*** ON 11/04/2013 AT 1809 HOURS,CSX MANAGER ENVIRONMENTAL FIELD SERVICES, REPORTED APPROXIMATELY EIGHT TO TEN GALLONS OF LUBE-OIL LEAKED ONTO TRACK BALLAST FROM LOCOMOTIVE CSXT 15158 NEAR MP QC 147.0 ON THE SELKIRK SUBDIVISON. THIS IS LOCATED ON THE WEST END OF THE DIESEL SHOP ON TRACK 5, WITHIN THE SELKIRK YARD AT ONE BELL CROSSING ROAD IN SELKIRK, NY. CALLER ADDED THAT THE LOCOMOTIVE HAD SYPHONED LUBE-OIL UP THROUGH THE TURBO-CHARGER AND LEAKED / SPRAYED IT ON THE TRACKS. MOST OF THE OIL WAS SOPPED UP BUY TRACK MATTING. NO WATERWAYS HAD BEEN AFFECTED AND THE WEATHER WAS CLEAR SKIES IN THE LOW 30'S. CSX CRISIS COMMUNICATIONS / HAZARDOUS MATERIALS MANAGER, WAS CONFERENCED IN WITH CALLER, AND ADVISED ENVIRONMENTAL CONTRACTORS WOULD BE NOTIFIED AND RESPONDING FOR CLEAN-UP. DISPATCHER PRESCOTT, BETHLEHEM POLICE DEPARTMENT, WAS ALSO NOTIFIED, AND ADVISED NO RESPONSE WAS NEEDED.
